questions.question: Which description fits the **DocumentManifest** resource?
options: A collection of documents compiled for a purpose together with metadata that applies to the collection.
A reference to a document of any kind for any purpose.
Catalog entries are wrappers that contextualize items included in a catalog.

A set of healthcare-related information that is assembled together into a single logical package that provides a single coherent statement of meaning, establishes its own context and that has clinical attestation with regard…
questions.explanation: **DocumentManifest**: A collection of documents compiled for a purpose together with metadata that applies to the collection. The other descriptions belong to **DocumentReference**, **CatalogEntry**, **Composition**.

questions.question: Which resource matches this definition from the specification? “A collection of documents compiled for a purpose together with metadata that applies to the collection.”
questions.explanation: This is the definition of **DocumentManifest** (Foundation › Documents).

questions.question: Where does **DocumentManifest** sit in the FHIR R4 resource list?
questions.explanation: **DocumentManifest** is in **Foundation › Documents**: Package and find clinical documents: Composition structures a FHIR document, DocumentReference describes any document (PDF, scan, CDA) so it can be found, and DocumentManifest groups documents.

questions.question: Which element is **required** (minimum cardinality 1) in every **DocumentManifest** instance?
questions.explanation: The required top-level elements of DocumentManifest are `status` (1..1), `content` (1..*). The other options have a minimum cardinality of 0, so they are optional.

questions.question: Which element of **DocumentManifest** is a **modifier** (?!), so receiving systems must not ignore it?
questions.explanation: Modifier elements of DocumentManifest: `status`. `status`: current | superseded | entered-in-error. A modifier can change the meaning of the whole resource: for example, a status of `entered-in-error` means the data must not be used.
